network.description: Network identity and logging settings (required for service mode)

network.nick.description: Nickname to use when connecting to the network. Required for IRC.

mode.detach.description: If false, run in foreground (like -c). If true, run as daemon (default).

mode.reset.description: If true, ignore config file and reset parameters (like -r, implies -c).

mode.fatal_only.description: If true, print only fatal errors to stderr (like -q).

file.path.description: Config file path — used with -g (generate) or -t (test). Leave empty to use CLI argument.

file.listfile.description: Path to channel/user listfile. Empty disables listfile.
